title: ID0447064-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / P9 170001030]-Säkylä stuck in empty hello screen
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
After maintenance visit, charger software got stuck in empty hello screen and not booting properly. Multiple main unit and dispenser reboots did not solve the issue. cFast card flash is needed
Solution: cFast card flashed and configure files moved in to cFast card
